notes.subject: מנדים/תגישון
notes.rationale: Pushing away the day versus bringing near the seat — the near/far antithesis of the two verbs is the verse's axis.

notes.subject: שֶׁבֶת חָמָס
notes.rationale: Rendered 'a session of violence'; alternatives: 'a reign of violence', 'a seat of violence', or 'the sitting of violence' (a throne of oppression).

notes.subject: וַתַּגִּישׁוּן
notes.rationale: The paragogic nun marks the 2nd-person verb 'you bring near', though the participle before it is 3rd-person description.

translation: The ones pushing away the day of disaster, and you bring near a session of violence.
